mapper.select: SELECT id FROM media_song WHERE id > #{cursor} AND source_id=#{source} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM audio_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND song_id=#{song}
SELECT * FROM audio_batch ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT state,category,COUNT(*) AS amount FROM audio_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{id} GROUP BY state,category

SELECT item.*,job.result_json AS execution,job.state AS job_state FROM audio_batch_item item LEFT JOIN media_audio_job job ON job.id=item.job_id WHERE item.batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY item.song_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT song_id FROM audio_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state='FAILED' ORDER BY song_id

SELECT item.*,batch.state AS batch_state,batch.backend FROM audio_batch_item item JOIN audio_batch batch ON batch.id=item.batch_id WHERE batch.state IN ('QUEUED','CANCELLED') AND item.state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','PROCESSING') ORDER BY item.updated_at,item.batch_id,item.song_id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE audio_batch SET state='QUEUED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PREVIEW'
UPDATE audio_batch SET state='CANCELLED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND state IN ('PREVIEW','QUEUED')

UPDATE audio_batch SET state='COMPLETED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND state='QUEUED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audio_batch_item WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','PROCESSING'))
UPDATE audio_batch_item SET state=#{state},job_id=#{job},error=#{error},updated_at=#{now} WHERE batch_id=#{batch} AND song_id=#{song} AND state IN ('PENDING','PROBING','PROCESSING')
UPDATE audio_batch_item SET state='CANCELLED',updated_at=#{now} WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state='PENDING' AND job_id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM audio_batch_item WHERE batch_id IN (SELECT id FROM audio_batch WHERE state='PREVIEW' AND created_at < #{before})
DELETE FROM audio_batch WHERE state='PREVIEW' AND created_at < #{before}
